subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin assertions are synchronized, should this grouped set of verified action releases be accepted for token-, release-, scanning-, and agent-capable workflows?
rationale: The proposed SHAs are authentic upstream release tags and do not broaden permissions, but the protected security label and secret-capable workflow scope require explicit human acceptance.

options.title: Accept after guard repair
options.body: Require the four assertion updates and green exact-head workflow checks, then accept the verified action releases.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, and Codex action upgrades into smaller PRs for independent review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Retain the existing pins until maintainers are ready to reassess the dependency set.

recommendation.title: Accept after guard repair
recommendation.body: Require the four assertion updates and green exact-head workflow checks, then accept the verified action releases.
